qAndA.answer: It's a force acting on a rotating body in space caused by the anisotropic emission of thermal photons, which carry momentum. In simpler terms, when sunlight heats one side of a rotating asteroid, the uneven heat radiation can slightly alter its trajectory over time.

Narrator encourages viewers to share the video and concludes. Visuals shift from the solar system simulation to the NASA logo.
